lines.beaver: 이번 발령 내용을 간략하게 설명해 주시겠어요?
lines.beaver_en: Could you briefly explain this appointment?
lines.beaver_roman: ibeon ballyeong naeyongeul gallyakage seolmyeonghae jusigesseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 박 국장님이 정년을 맞아 퇴임하세요.
lines.en: Yes, Director General Park is retiring at retirement age.
lines.roman: ne, bak gukjangnimi jeongnyeoneul maja toeimhaseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then who will be the successor?
lines.learner: 이 부장님이 국장으로 임명되어 다음 달에 부임하세요.
lines.en: Manager Lee was appointed director and starts next month.
lines.roman: i bujangnimi gukjangeuro immyeongdoeeo daeum dare buimhaseyo.

lines.learner: 네, 임원진 두 명이 새로 취임할 예정이에요.
lines.en: Yes, two new executives will take office.
lines.roman: ne, imwonjin du myeongi saero chwiimhal yejeongieyo.

lines.beaver: 현직 간부 중에 자리를 옮기는 분도 있나요?
lines.beaver_en: Are any current officers moving posts?
lines.beaver_roman: hyeonjik ganbu junge jarireul omgineun bundo innayo?
lines.learner: 최 과장님은 부산 지사로 파견되어 상주하세요.
lines.en: Manager Choi is being sent to stay at the Busan branch.
lines.roman: choe gwajangnimeun busan jisaro pagyeondoeeo sangjuhaseyo.

lines.learner: 맞아요. 저희 팀만 해도 일이 두 배로 늘어요.
lines.en: Right. My team alone will have double the work.
lines.roman: majayo. jeohui timman haedo iri du baero neureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Any news of staff cuts or dismissals?
lines.learner: 감원은 없어요. 다만 한 분이 휴직을 신청했어요.
lines.en: No cuts. But one person applied for leave.
lines.roman: gamwoneun eopseoyo. daman han buni hyujigeul sincheonghaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Who will take over that person's duties?
lines.learner: 회계팀 출신 신입이 맡는데, 실력이 경력직과 맞먹어요.
lines.en: A new hire from accounting, as skilled as a veteran.
lines.roman: hoegyetim chulsin sinibi manneunde, sillyeogi gyeongnyeokjikgwa manmeogeoyo.

lines.beaver: 휴직 공백 동안 근무 조정은 어떻게 하나요?
lines.beaver_en: How will shifts be adjusted during the leave?
lines.beaver_roman: hyujik gongbaek dongan geunmu jojeongeun eotteoke hanayo?
lines.learner: 직원들끼리 휴무를 바꿔 가며 공백을 메워요.
lines.en: Staff swap days off to cover the gap.
lines.roman: jigwondeulkkiri hyumureul bakkwo gamyeo gongbaegeul memwoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What is the new director like?
lines.learner: 영업 간부 출신으로 이 회사에서 이십 년 근무하셨어요.
lines.en: A former sales officer, he's worked here twenty years.
lines.roman: yeongeop ganbu chulsineuro i hoesaeseo isip nyeon geunmuhasyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 설명 감사합니다. 발령 통보는 내일 하겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks for explaining. I'll send the notice tomorrow.
lines.beaver_roman: seolmyeong gamsahamnida. ballyeong tongboneun naeil hagetseumnida.
lines.learner: 네, 감사합니다. 발령 공지 후 다시 연락드릴게요.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll contact you after the announcement.
lines.roman: ne, gamsahamnida. ballyeong gongji hu dasi yeollakdeurilgeyo.
